snippet.title: Twinkle's Galactic Tour ► "Wildest Dream" Trailer at Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase
snippet.description:
Wrapped up in a vibrant, ‘90s low-poly anime style, Twinkle’s Galactic Tour is a 3D adventure game that infuses musical rhythm into its platforming core. Play as Twinkle, an aspiring singer who has a dilemma to solve... her debut concert's a disaster, and now all of her fans have been kidnapped! True to its musical core, the game uniquely syncs enemy movements, platforms, and items to the beat and melody of the soundtrack, creating a dynamic platforming experience. 

Beyond platforming, players can explore an open neon-and-pastel city hub, complete side-quests, craft gear, and get closer to a colorful cast of characters through a 'hangout system', all while uncovering a heartfelt narrative about striving to make it as an artist. Will Twinkle catch the culprit and serve justice? Find out her footing in the harsh career of music? Which friends will you choose to make? Maybe even find your love in the midst of it all?

From the developer of the charming, PS1-style low-poly retro tribute game Frogun (released in 2022).

Features/call-outs:
- Rhythm-based platforming: Catch the melody and move in sync to avoid enemies and obstacles
- A charming, vibrant neon low-poly style that calls back to the glory days of the Dreamcast
- Explore the hub to meet characters, complete challenges, complete side-quests, and shop for useful gear and costumes.
- 'Hangout System' - build relationships, experience personal stories, and get collectibles from your friends
- Find hidden CDs, gather collectibles, and find secrets across both levels and the core hub.
